reviewCandidates.title: 사용자별 수정 권한이 넓게 선언되어 있습니다
reviewCandidates.reason: 명시적 쓰기 권한과 행 접근 선언에서 사용자별 제한이 없는 작업 또는 UPDATE의 기존 행·변경 후 행 중 한쪽만 제한된 작업을 확인했습니다. 의도적인 공유 데이터인지와 운영 적용 상태는 별도 확인이 필요합니다.
reviewCandidates.recommendation: 공유 데이터인지 먼저 확인하고, 사용자 전용 데이터라면 해당 작업의 기존 행 조건(USING)과 새 행 조건(WITH CHECK)에 실제 소유자 컬럼과 auth.uid() 비교를 적용하세요. 여러 permissive 정책과 GRANT도 함께 검토하세요.
verificationSteps: 격리 테스트 환경에서 사용자 A·B의 조회·수정·삭제와 소유자 변경을 각각 확인하세요.
익명 사용자와 관리자 경로를 따로 검사하고 실제 적용 migration·GRANT·역할을 대조한 뒤 재검사하세요.

oracle.extension: Exact already-frozen broad policy packet added to the oracle; original requirements, packets and earlier 288 results retained.

resources.protocol: Same serialized packets and Node binary; alternating sequential before/after; two warmups each; no own concurrent evaluation or DB jobs. Host OS load/CPU affinity not controlled.

failureCasePack.cause: Valid column REVOKE was unsupported and invalidated the scope, hiding a broad row-policy review even though table UPDATE remained.
failureCasePack.before: UNKNOWN and no matching policy review candidate
failureCasePack.fix: Separate direct/PUBLIC table UPDATE and per-column UPDATE grants; preserve table privilege through column REVOKE and clear column grants on table REVOKE.
failureCasePack.tests: column-update.test.mjs, original 36 regression, new 36 frozen controls and isolated PostgreSQL

limitations: Grade B protected-property requirements are explicit oracle inputs, not product inputs. Field names do not determine sensitivity.

Two restored candidates describe broad row-policy declarations, not new protected-property detection or confirmed HTTP privilege bypass. Application user-ID filters do not prove direct DB policy isolation.
Validation uses Server Functions and renamed schema fields, but the same author and scenario family; not independent projects or blind holdout.
Inherited privileges, owners/admins, grantor/column existence, deployed state and actual DB roles remain unknown. NOT_ESTABLISHED is not denial.
Column SELECT/INSERT and all query prerequisites are not implemented. DELETE is not a column privilege.

Two FAILED Coverage ledgers represent deliberately injected missing SQL marked LIMIT_EXCEEDED by the evaluation acquisition plan, not Worker crashes or newly exhausted execution budgets. Their Worker/RLS snapshots remain PARTIAL/UNKNOWN. Score 100 does not certify whole-project safety.
The initial 288 oracle results are retained; 24 checks for the exact already-frozen broad SQL packet were added without modifying truth or sources.
No new Grade A pair was acquired, no operating Supabase/HTTP attack or live GitHub App was tested. Mock provider tests do not validate a real AI model.
